pillar.description: The flagship themes of your brand. Picked well, they turn a random-posting account into a real strategy.
pillar.whatIsP1: A content pillar is a broad theme you'll cover regularly. Think of it as a column of your strategy: every video you produce should fit under one pillar.
pillar.whatIsP2: The golden rule: between 3 and 5 pillars max. Fewer, and you'll repeat yourself. More, and your audience will lose the plot.
pillar.step1: Set your goal and target. Why are you posting (awareness, community, sales)? Who are you talking to?
pillar.step2: Brainstorm wide. List everything: tips, customer questions, behind-the-scenes, stories. Aim for 30-50 raw ideas.
pillar.step3: Group into 3-5 pillars. Organize ideas into broad families. If a family only has 3-4 ideas → it's not a pillar.
pillar.step4Intro: Balance your pillars using the Know-Like-Trust method:
pillar.step4a: Educational — you demonstrate your expertise (tips, tutorials)
pillar.step4b: Relational — you show behind-the-scenes, the team, your daily life
pillar.step4c: Inspirational — your values, your vision, what triggers a reaction
pillar.step4d: Promotional — your offers, your results, customer testimonials
pillar.step5: Build your idea bank. In Kreatly, each pillar becomes a filter: you'll attach Reels and Stories to it as ideas come.
pillar.test: For each pillar, ask yourself: "Can I come up with at least 30 video ideas without breaking a sweat?" If yes → it's a real pillar. If not → merge it or drop it.
pillar.example1: Business coach — Marketing tips (educational), Entrepreneur routine (behind-the-scenes), Mindset & discipline (inspirational), Client testimonials (promo)
pillar.example2: Natural cosmetics brand — Beauty tips (educational), Workshop production (behind-the-scenes), Zero waste & values (inspirational), Product showcases (promo)
pillar.example3: Local restaurant — Recipes & techniques (educational), A day in the kitchen (behind-the-scenes), Local producers (inspirational), Dish of the day & events (promo)
pillar.mohtawa1: You'll find the list in the "Content pillar" dropdown of each video (just above).
pillar.mohtawa2: The orange + button to the right of the menu lets you add a new pillar on the fly, without leaving the video.
pillar.mohtawa3: In the Analytics tab, your pillars are ranked by performance: you can see which one brings in the most views.
pillar.mohtawa4: You can manage your full taxonomy (add, rename, delete) from Brands → [your brand].
pillar.tip: Tip: start with 3 pillars only. You can always add a 4th or 5th later, once you've mastered the first ones.

beta.title: Join the early creators
beta.description: Kreatly is in free beta. In exchange for your feedback, keep lifetime free access when we launch paid plans.

q1.question: Is it really free?
q1.answer: Yes, 100% free during the beta. No credit card, no trial period. Beta testers will keep lifetime free access when we launch paid plans.

q2.question: Is my data private?
q2.answer: Yes. Your videos, scripts and performance numbers are hosted on Supabase (Postgres + RLS) and only accessible to you and your team. We don't sell anything and we don't train AI models on your data.

q3.question: How does the AI work?
q3.answer: We use Claude (by Anthropic) to generate structured scripts. You give the title, goal and pillar — the AI proposes a full structure (hook, points, CTA, outro) you can edit freely.

q4.question: Does Kreatly publish for me?
q4.answer: No. Kreatly is a planner, not an auto-poster. You publish yourself on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube. We help you prepare, structure, measure.

q5.question: Is Arabic well supported?
q5.answer: Yes — full interface in Arabic with native RTL, a dedicated Cairo font, and the 70-hook library fully translated. Switch EN/FR/AR any time.

q6.question: Can I work with a team?
q6.answer: Yes. Invite teammates with a magic link, with 4 roles (owner, admin, editor, viewer). Threaded comments on every block, notification inbox, "resolved" status.

q7.question: Does it work on mobile?
q7.answer: The app is responsive and usable on mobile. Some pages (calendar, storyboard) are better on desktop. A dedicated mobile experience is coming soon.

q8.question: How do I delete my account?
q8.answer: Email us from your account and we'll delete everything in under 24h. No data retained.
